schat.label: %1$s: %2$s
schat.hint.reset: MMB: reset, Shift+MMB: save as default
schat.tab.hint: LMB — open, RMB — settings, MMB — close, drag — pull out into its own chat
schat.tab.hint.last: LMB — open, RMB — settings. The last tab of the main chat can be neither closed nor pulled out: the chat would be left empty
schat.tab.hint.add: New tab with the settings of the first one
schat.tab.hint.settings: Tab settings: name, background, history, repeats, buttons, filters
schat.settings.title: Tab settings
schat.settings.name: Name
schat.settings.color.tip: Colour. Clicking cycles all 16 Minecraft colours, the button shows a sample
schat.settings.stack.tip: Identical messages that arrive back to back collapse into one line with a counter. If another message lands between them, they stay separate
schat.settings.stack.format.tip: Counter layout. %s is where the repeat count goes
schat.settings.all.stack.tip: Apply these repeat settings to every tab in every panel
schat.settings.nick.tip: Append a button that copies the player nickname found in the message. The nickname is matched against the server player list. If AdminTool already added such a button, a second one is not inserted
schat.settings.nick.format.tip: Button label. %s is where the nickname goes
schat.settings.all.nick.tip: Apply these nickname button settings to every tab in every panel
schat.settings.copy.tip: Button at the end of the message that copies it whole. The repeat counter never reaches the clipboard — the original text is copied
schat.settings.all.copy.tip: Apply these copy button settings to every tab in every panel
schat.settings.exclusive.tip: Messages this tab matches disappear from every other tab in every chat, including the catch-all one. Off: a message shows up everywhere it fits
schat.settings.unread.tip: Whether to show the unread count on this tab. A hidden tab does not bring up the tab strip while the chat is closed
schat.settings.all.unread.tip: Apply this counter setting to every tab in every chat
schat.settings.servers.tip: Where to show this tab. Empty — everywhere. Otherwise a list of addresses separated by commas or spaces, for example: holyworld.ru, *.holyworld.ru, play.example.net. The asterisk stands for any subdomain. On other servers the tab is hidden and receives no messages
schat.settings.all.servers.tip: Apply this server list to every tab in every chat
schat.settings.tab.opacity.tip: Opacity of this tab's plate in the strip. An inactive tab is always slightly dimmer than the active one
schat.settings.tab.background.tip: Tab plate colour. Clicking cycles all 16 Minecraft colours, the button itself is painted in the chosen one
schat.settings.tab.text.tip: Tab name colour. Clicking cycles all 16 Minecraft colours, the button itself is painted in the chosen one
schat.settings.all.tab.tip: Apply this tab colour and opacity to every tab in every chat
schat.settings.tabs.tip: Where to draw this chat's tab strip — above it or below it. The setting belongs to the whole chat, not to a single tab
schat.settings.filter.strip.tip: Cut this part out of the displayed text. You already know the message matches it, so there is no point seeing it on every line. Works only for conditions without "not"
schat.settings.filters.mode.tip: How several conditions are combined. "Any" — one match is enough. "All" — the message must satisfy every condition at once, for example start with one word and end with another. "not ..." bans always apply, whatever the mode
schat.settings.name.tip: Tab name shown in the strip above the chat
schat.settings.opacity.tip: Opacity of the black backdrop behind this tab's messages. Until the slider is moved, the game setting is used
schat.settings.history.tip: How many messages this tab keeps. Longer history means deeper scrollback, but resizing the chat costs more
schat.settings.filter.add.tip: Add a condition. A tab with no conditions shows everything
schat.settings.filter.mode.tip: Match condition. Clicking cycles all six: contains, does not contain, starts with, does not start with, ends with, does not end with
schat.settings.filter.text.tip: Word or phrase to match. Case and colour codes are ignored
schat.settings.all.opacity.tip: Apply this opacity to every tab in every panel
schat.settings.all.history.tip: Apply this history length to every tab in every panel
schat.settings.all.filters.tip: Copy these conditions to every tab in every panel, replacing their own
schat.settings.done.tip: Close settings and return to the chat
